question: Preserve population question and criteria byte-for-byte.
guard: Use unchanged l8 whole-candidate question and rendering from the accepted admission screen; no focus field in this guard state.
statistic: Minimum of every valid contextual-focus score and unchanged l8 whole-candidate guard score for the same candidate and pass. Missing, invalid, or absent component means unscored, never zero.
ordering: Forward: population opaque-id row order; within each row, all spans ascending start, then whole-candidate guard. Reverse: exact reverse of the full forward atomic request sequence.

pairs.boundary: condition or prerequisite expressed across spans
later correction governing an earlier fact
explicitly inactive history versus a current assertion

acceptance: For each frozen matched boundary pair, the supported candidate minimum must strictly exceed its unsafe counterpart separately in both passes. The original supported anchor focus must strictly exceed the unsupported anchor focus separately in both passes. Every component must have complete exact-body/raw-response custody, valid readout and replay, and stable frozen identities. Ties or reversals refuse the screen; missing or invalid evidence is incomplete.
limits: The original complete anchors are unsupported and ambiguous, respectively, not a supported/unsafe whole-candidate pair. Report every component and whole statistic against settled labels, but do not invent an ordering between those whole anchors. No cutoff fitting, canonical change, probability interpretation, quality comparison, or adoption follows from this screen.
retry: No retries, wording alternatives, label edits, or deletion of failing cases. Retain failed prefixes. Any operational successor requires a recorded root ruling.
successor: Only a passing screen proceeds to a minimal canonical implementation and fresh complete-cohort qualification with unchanged admission criteria; a local pass is insufficient to qualify aggregates.
